data: Which probing task achieves the highest accuracy for char-d7?

The question asks which probing task achieves the highest accuracy for char-d7. From the caption, we know there are three probing tasks: grammatical, locative, and infinitive. The figure shows three graphs corresponding to these tasks. 

Looking at the graph for char-d7 (black line), we can see that the grammatical probing task (leftmost graph) has the highest accuracy among the three tasks. The grammatical probing task starts at approximately 90% accuracy and maintains a relatively high value throughout the layers, while the other two tasks show lower and more fluctuating accuracy values. Therefore, the grammatical probing task achieves the highest accuracy for char-d7.
